note: Marinette County rustic campground on the North Branch of the Pike River, with Twelve Foot and Eight Foot Falls a short walk from the sites. Seven sites on the upper loop by the entrance road, five on the lower loop south of the picnic area. Only sites 1, 9, 10 and 12 are 24 ft long or more (1 and 12 are 40 ft); the rest are 12-20 ft. --Claude
summary: County page, 12 per-site pages, 2027 fee schedule, reservation policy and 2019 map read: $20 non-electric (2027 unchanged) + $10 reservation fee; 184-day window, 14-in-21 max; May 1 - Oct 15; 12 sites, only 4 of them 24 ft+; vault toilets, hand pump, no dump (Twin Bridge Park). Riverview -> not waterfront (both loops under canopy, river 60 m+ through trees).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored riverview (sweep value, no --AWH) -> not waterfront. Esri imagery (hw 200 m at 45.5806,-88.1360): the lower loop (sites 8-12, ~45.5798,-88.1359) sits under continuous canopy ~60-70 m west of the North Branch Pike River with the dog-walking trail and forest between; the upper loop (1-7) is farther west by the entrance road. The river is open only at the falls pools. The branch is also well under 30 m wide here, so any on-water value would be creekside, not riverfront.

FIT: only 4 of 12 sites are 24 ft long or more by the county's site dimensions - 1 (20x40), 9 (10x24), 10 (20x30), 12 (14x40); the other eight are 12-20 ft. A 23-ft rig fits those four; kept, with the note naming them.
